title: The 5 Marketing Concepts Explained Simply | Marketing Management Ep 2
description:
Zoya asks one question: how do we sell more laddoos? Arjun says make more, Nani says make it better, Dev says push harder. Each answer is a different way of thinking, and in marketing that is called an orientation. In this animated lesson, Laddoo Lab, a tiny millet laddoo brand from a home kitchen in Bengaluru, tries all five marketing concepts one by one.

You will see the production, product, selling, marketing and societal marketing concepts that Philip Kotler describes, each one run live on the same kitchen-to-customer flow: 200 laddoos a day at a lower cost, a superb laddoo that gets too expensive, a sales spike that falls away, steady weekly sales from busy parents, and paper packs that are better for the city. Then we meet Theodore Levitt's 1960 Harvard Business Review article Marketing Myopia and his railroad example, and Zoya asks what business Laddoo Lab is really in. We spot the five concepts at work today, in a budget airline, a phone maker, an insurance agent, a bank and a food delivery app. We also look at the human side honestly: caring for society builds trust but costs more, and since 1 July 2022 India has banned many single-use plastic items, including the plastic film on sweet boxes.

This is Episode 2 of our Marketing Management series for MBA, BBA and commerce students.
